value.rationale: The established structural classification isolates four canonical cubic symmetric girth-six graphs; fault-tolerant Hamilton endpoint universality is a natural, strictly stronger path property than ordinary laceability. The result resolves the entire deleted-vertex admissible endpoint spectrum of all four, shows the sharp exceptional boundary in Möbius–Kantor, and characterizes its single obstruction invariantly by graph distances. This has nontrivial mathematical meaning beyond arbitrary finite enumeration.
